req.title: Login form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /auth/login must return an HTTP 2xx response with a login form payload. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying exact status 200 and presence of key HTML form elements; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that an unsupported method (POST with no data still returns 200 but a wrong HTTP verb like DELETE returns 405, confirming the route is GET-only for form serving); (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the response Content-Type header is text/html and the body contains both 'username' and 'password' input fields — catching mutations that alter the template rendering path or status code constant. Each test is self-contained, uses in-process Flask test client, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

preconditions: Flask app is created with TESTING=True and a temporary database
actions: Send GET /auth/login via Flask test client
expected: Response body contains login form HTML with username and password fields
trace: R-FLASKR-007: GET /auth/login shall return HTTP 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_form_get_returns_200_with_form_html():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'username' in r.data
    assert b'password' in r.data
    assert b'<form' in r.data
    assert 'text/html' in r.content_type

test_login_form_get_returns_200_with_form_html()

No user session is active (anonymous client)

expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200, not any 3xx redirect
No Location header pointing away from /auth/login

BVA: boundary between 2xx and 3xx status codes
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_form_get_response_is_not_redirect():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/login', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code < 300
    assert r.status_code >= 200
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/auth/login' not in location or location == ''
    assert b'<form' in r.data

test_login_form_get_response_is_not_redirect()
